text_block_list.text:
I find some time to drop by the dance
studio...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right hand, left hand, step back! Raise
both
hands and swing them—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Sorry about that! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't wait to take center stage
and put on
an awesome show at my
winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've been pumped up like crazy ever
since I saw
Dia's concert!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yep! Dia's incredible! She shines so brilliantly on stage, you'd think she was a real diamond!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She's fearless, you know? And it really shows in her performances! They even got me worked up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She's so effortlessly cool—I wanna be
able to
dance like her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But when I start thinking about it all, my
head
gets all mixed up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Advice... Yeah, good idea! I'll go ask
some of the
Umamusume I look up to!
choice_data_list: Why not ask someone for advice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...So please, Teio! I beg you! Tell me the
secret to
putting on an amazing concert!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho, this is my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, all right! Listen closely! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First, let's get a video of you dancing!
We can do
it together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-I get to dance with you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You there! Come on over and record us
with your
phone!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew, okay. Let's see how it turned out...
Hit play!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-next to you, it's super obvious how clumsy I am. This is so embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm... I'm not sure clumsiness is the issue
here. I'd
say it's something more... basic?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita, you were focused entirely on me
while you
were dancing, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I... I was! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I like your honesty! But I
shouldn't be your
focus during a concert,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, my favorite thing about
concerts is
when everyone tells me how
cool I am!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I used to shout about how cool Prez was, and now I'm the one receiving the cheers! Pretty amazing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why I always dance my heart out!
It's like,
"Check it out! I won! I'm the
best!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What about you? How do you feel when
you're up
on that stage?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How do I feel? Well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At Teio's winning concerts, I used to
scream until
my voice went out...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And this time, there are going to be just as many people cheering me on...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That makes me feel so... so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I get it now. Dia must have understood
this
feeling—that's why she looked so
awesome out
there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio! I wanna put on a super cool
performance
that'll make the crowd go
wild!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good, good. That's the first hurdle
cleared! Now
all you gotta do is put in
the work!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's get back to practicing!

It looks like the idea of expressing her
feelings through her performance has
helped Kitasan
Black make some
progress.
